About

About Us

Sound of Text is a fast, free, and accessible text-to-speech web application built to convert written text into natural spoken audio and downloadable MP3 files.

Project Origin & Author

Sound of Text was originally created as an open-source project by developer NC Pierson (GitHub: @ncpierson) as part of the soundtext.org initiative. It remains a lightweight, accessible tool for users around the globe.

Our Mission

We aim to empower creators, educators, students, and developers worldwide with instantaneous voice synthesis without requiring software downloads, registration, or hidden fees.

Technology & Method

Our tool leverages browser-native speech synthesis and trusted cloud API endpoints to deliver clear audio across 60+ languages and regional accents. Whether you are generating WhatsApp voice notes, creating video voiceovers, or practicing language pronunciation, Sound of Text provides reliable audio conversion in seconds.

Contact & Support

Have questions or feedback? Reach out to us via our Contact Page.
